messages:
Sam: noticed a small but consistent blip after the streaming UX flag flip — customers seeing two billing hits when a connection is closed then immediately re-opened.
Vera: I saw a few traces. runtime returns 204 on resume but billing shows a new session create + a resume charge.
Ken: any repro steps? could be proxy dropping close payload or resume header on retry which breaks idempotency.
Sam: repro I used: open WS, server sends CLOSE with resume payload, client reconnects within 2s. server accepted resume but quota shows two increments. logs: 
Sam: ```
Server -> CLOSE code=4001 payload={"resume":true, "token":"rt-1337"}
Proxy -> forwards only close code, payload dropped
Client -> reconnect -> full auth -> new session token issued
Quota -> increment session_tokens for new-token
Quota -> also recorded resume charge
```
Vera: that would explain it. we added custom payloads for resume in runtime v2 but some LB paths strip body on CLOSE.
Ken: short-term: make proxy preserve a resume hint header (X-Resume-Allowed: true) for close frames so clients know to attempt resume instead of fresh auth. I'll open a fast PR.
QuotaSvc: note: quota service currently treats any new auth as a fresh session; resume path not integrated into deduper.
Sam: medium-term: emit a resume_fingerprint on both close and resume events (hash(token + client_id)) and have QuotaSvc dedupe increments within a configurable window (default 15s).
Vera: add telemetry fix too: console sampling is low for streams (2%) while billing is unsampled. we need the fingerprint on every billing event so sampled traces can be correlated to charges.
Ken: deployment plan: (1) proxy header patch -> canary 5% (short window), (2) QuotaSvc dedupe flag off by default; enable for small orgs after PR validation, (3) add a Grafana card comparing resume_requests vs new_session_creates.
DeployBot: canary 5% -> paused pending Ken's PR review.
QuotaSvc: when enabling dedupe, we will tag deduped events with "dedup=true" and keep raw counts for 48h for auditing.
ConsoleUI: will add dashboard panel and a debug field in session inspector showing last-close-payload and resume_fingerprint. useful for support.
Sam: tests: add e2e that sends CLOSE with resume payload -> client reconnects inside 5s -> assert single billing increment. also unit for proxy close passthrough.
Vera: small UX ask: surface sticky-lease TTL and proxy idle-close in the rollout banner so PMs can tune.
Ken: assigned tasks: proxy header PR + tests. Vera -> QuotaSvc dedupe spec + migration. Sam -> dashboard & alert (ratio resume_charges/unique_resume_fp > 1.02 for 10m). Follow-up in 8h. :thumbsup:
